E1_outcome_summary_HOLDOUT_DTI.note: All values HOLDOUT-DTI, gems57-pooled-hide-v2, seed 20, 11321 withheld positives; evidence/h78sig_holdout_seed20.json

E2_method_paragraph: Rank fusion: production-ranking surface = mean of within-footprint percentile ranks of the CTRL_A2 (habitat+signature) and SIGX (signature-only, cross-resolution) surfaces fitted in E1 on identical folds/sample; identical greedy emitter; flank B in {3,5}; budgets {37654,44090}. No new learner is fitted in E2.
mechanism: The two detectors' errors are partially independent (surface rho 0.698): habitat bands localise strain-controlled fault corridors, signature-only bands localise sub-100 m scarps irrespective of corridor. Rank fusion hedges the unknown distance distribution of the expert new-fault labels (organizers declined to describe coverage: community thread 11527, fetched 2026-10-22).
endpoints: Identical to E1: overall + far>10px + far>20px pooled HOLDOUT-DTI with paired CIs vs CTRL_A2|B3, CTRL_A2|B5, SIGX|B5 (E1 terms recomputed from saved surfaces for exact pairing), D2.8, random.
uniqueness_precheck: Forward 3 px dot overlap of every FUSE config vs the shipped H78-A production raster and vs H33/D2.8, computed on holdout dots before any production build; >0.70 vs H78-A = duplicate stop for E2 (fall back to E1 SIGX selection).
promotion_rule: Production uses FUSE only if (a) uniqueness precheck passes, (b) FUSE far>10px >= max(CTRL_B5, SIGX_B5) point estimate OR its paired delta vs both has CI including positive values with overall >= SIGX overall; otherwise production uses the E1 selection SIGX|B5|44090. Whichever surface is chosen, gates G1-G5 in research/h78sig_hypotheses.md are re-run on the production file.
